label: prop:q-beta-bar-even-kernel-typeclass
title: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ formalize-first unified typeclass — bundling the four §4 invariants (bar-even, radius-of-convergence, $q=1$ shadow, direction sanity) into one parametric Lean typeclass so any future kernel candidate $F(q)$ becomes a single class-instance attempt
html:
The BarEvenKernel Lean typeclass bundles all four formalize-first invariants for F(q) into a single parametric type. Instantiating BarEvenKernel is equivalent to clearing all four gates simultaneously.

This bundles the radius-of-convergence, bar-even, q=1 shadow, and direction-sanity checks into a single step for Lean. It operationalises the pre-flight checklist. The \S 4(a) field encodes the radius-of-convergence conjecture as a test condition; the class defines the checklist and does not assert that conjecture. The bar-even invariant is a structural identity in CommRing R. The composition theorem lifts the bundle into the individual gate classes.
heading: Proposition
